solutionSql:
SELECT id, status
FROM shipment_scans_large
WHERE id BETWEEN 1 AND 50
  AND status LIKE 'del%'
ORDER BY id;
ambiguities: "Begins with del" does not say whether the match is case-sensitive. LIKE is case-sensitive here, but every status is lowercase, so the answer is the same either way.
The instructions say a prefix match can use an index, but status has no index in this schema and planRequirement is null, so no plan is graded. This did not change the answer.
notes: Result is 12 rows, ids 3, 7, 11 and so on to 47, all delivered. Same on all three datasets.
